name: THE MAN UPSTREAM
note: Doc 109, THE MAN UPSTREAM: 'Alone at the head of the gulch, guarding the best ground with a shovel. Sure the panner has found something bigger.' He stands on the gravel among the crossing stakes where the composition master stood him (room-54 operation 1), his tent behind him on the claim line. His tree and barks are doc 109's, extracted; doc 49's ROOM 54 answers a wrong verb on him (errata 202). Barks in turn, the same in every reputation state: the Gulch has not heard of Thad (doc 107).
walkToNote: WHERE THAD STANDS TO TALK TO HIM: on the gravel at the edge of the stakes, a step nearer the camera, not among them (doc 55 section 8: beside them, nobody hidden).

sprite.note: Frames 0-1 are the idle: standing guard, both hands on the shovel's handle, and its breath. Frame 2 is the shovel lifted, its blade tapping something beside him, warningly (doc 109's LISTEN); frame 3 a look down the river; frame 4 a long sigh, head back. Frame 5 is talking, an arm out, pointing.
sprite.frameNote: 0 rest, guarding · 1 breath · 2 the shovel tapping, warningly · 3 a look down the river · 4 a long sigh · 5 talking, pointing.

lines: Did he send you? He sent you.
Not a step past that stake.
Tell him I'm not worried. Tell him loudly.
